justification: OC-21 addition: an address whose council has withheld area rules says so on its page. The list data/chapter_scope/not_covered_2026-10-15.json is exported to frontend-nextjs/shared/not-covered-councils.json by scripts/export_not_covered_councils.py; for-property meta.not_covered carries the served council's chapters or null; DcpNotCoveredNotice renders a plain amber note in ProvisionsByTocStructure. Per council because the areas have no outline.

falsifiable_check.command: cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest __tests__/api/not-covered-meta.test.ts __tests__/components/compliance/DcpNotCoveredNotice.test.tsx && cd .. && python -m pytest tests/test_not_covered_councils_drift.py
falsifiable_check.fails_when: a council listed in the data file gets meta.not_covered null, an unlisted council gets non-null, the notice does not render, or the shared JSON differs from the data file
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Drift test fails if the shared file is stale (compares render(build()) to the file); the meta test asserts null for parramatta and non-null for Leichhardt.

real_layer_exempt.scripts/export_not_covered_councils.py: reads one local JSON file, no database

pre_impl.existing_data: no existing frontend reader of the not-covered list; DcpLandApplicationNotice is a per-property LEP gate
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: none found; the route already keys councils with councilKey
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: one export script, one lib, one notice component

functions.name: getNotCovered
functions.input: the former_council request parameter, any spelling
functions.output: council slug and chapter list, or null
functions.if_none: returns null so no notice is shown

functions.name: build
functions.input: every withheld_area_rules entry in the data file
functions.output: map of council slug to chapter rows
functions.if_none: returns an empty map and writes an empty file

break_it.scenario: council name spelled differently (Inner West former councils, City of X)
break_it.what_happens: the notice is silently missing for that address
break_it.how: uses councilKey, the same key the route uses for rules

break_it.what_happens: prototype property returned as a list

mutation_analysis: Returning null from getNotCovered fails the meta and component tests; returning data for every council fails the parramatta null test.
residual_risk: Per council, so addresses outside the unmapped areas also see the notice. Chapter names are derived from chapter_key, not titles. The land-application withheld early return has no not_covered field (no rules are shown there anyway).
